_OPAL_ is a parallel open-source tool for charged-particle optics in linear accelerators and rings, including 3D space charge. Using the _MAD_ language with extensions, it runs on laptops as well as on the largest high-performance computing systems.

_OPALX_ is the performance-portable rewrite of _OPAL_, targeting NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel GPUs while remaining usable on local clusters and laptops. It keeps the same extended _MAD_ language and is intended to be mostly backward compatible with _OPAL_, with this manual documenting the differences explicitly.
